note: Metronome v1 riders: listings the same client re-fetched in list B's lockstep hours that the 2026-08-31 correlation sweep missed - popular enough that organic traffic hid them, or joining only after an update. Found by detect-metronome and reviewed 2026-10-25 (KNOWN_INCIDENTS.md metronome v1 entry): each rider's excess per loop hour over the same-day neighbouring hours was significant (local t 7-58), absent under +/-2-5h placebo shifts, and carried by one version whose daily growth tracked the loop's slot count. Attribution follows the loop's own clock (rider_targets): per snapshot day, per_cycle x list B's lockstep hours, rounded down and capped by the version's raw growth; per_cycle is the measured excess rounded down to 0.05 (mean - SE for windows under 30 slots). One entry per (version, window): riders re-fetched the version they last updated to. Baseline fields are unused by rider targets. Closed: v1 died 2026-09-06/09.
